meta.title: Provod spending
meta.description: Spending panel for a Provod workspace: the account balance, today and month-to-date totals, a month-end forecast, what is still needed to month end, spending by day, a model breakdown (top 10 with a Show all button) and model efficiency. A Provod management key is required; paste it into the Key section and it stays in DSH. An exact balance also needs a regular PROVOD_API_KEY; without it the balance is a credits-minus-usage estimate marked “≈”. Each refresh makes up to five requests to api.provod.ai from this machine and sends only the keys and date ranges. Analytics is limited to 2 requests per second and 30 per minute; the panel paces its queries. Turning the plugin off removes the page and its routes; no session data is read.
